column1: # The seeds of the round being exported RIGHT NOW, written at creation time and
# overwritten every round — the same handoff shape as midpoint-seeds-to-open.tsv,
# not a history. It exists because the 2026-08-17 crash left three downloaded zips
# with nothing in the repo saying what they were: the seed IDs are the whole state
# of a round, and they are cheap to write down and expensive to reconstruct.
# Empty below the header means no round is mid-flight.
